decisions.reason: Uses symptom-log and contrast-probe to localize the fault to the api-workspace-files Remote/provider chain: the tab claims and titles the session-scoped file while meta.status stays 'none', and file-trace's own RPC reads the same file, ruling out disk existence, permissions, path encoding, and scope rejection. Explicitly notes the workspace-files host row is already in cordis.patch.yml so static serving/declaration does not prove activation, and does not invent an exact internal failing function.

Correctly treats the per-module 62/62 sweep (and single manifest combo URL) as the valid static-serving measurement and rejects the hand-joined ~4-5 KB 404 as a request nothing serves, warning it must never be cited as missing modules. Explains the real loader fetches per boot-manifest entry URLs rather than one giant join, recognizing the bounded fetch mechanism without needing the exact byte constant; no invented reconciliation of the 60-vs-62 count.

Separates the dsh-paste-input fold warnings as an unrelated plugin's warning-only family with no red errors from the resource system, and uses the boot manifest to explain textpreview→documentpreview rename plus the session-only canOpen scope, showing that scope explains the absolute-address claim failure (Symptom A) but not the stalled metadata of the opened session tab (Symptom B). No demand for the fold-parser fix version or END-marker cause.

Orders: full host restart once (cheap, browser refresh explicitly not a host stop) → pinned rollback to a verified published version (cites discussion-excerpt's 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch) → upstream follow-up. Explicitly rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback and notes the host chain is the fault; treats the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art / failure family rather than proof alpha.2 still has missing bytes.

Packages versions, profile upgrade history, exact addresses, full roster with revs, valid per-module sweep plus the invalid-join caveat, same-file contrast with meta.status 'none', restart outcome, and logs. Proposes named host diagnostics: boot-time roster/serve self-check and an assertion that every Remote (workspace-files) has an active provider at boot, failing loud instead of an empty tab.

caps.reason: The report's final diagnosis says modules demonstrably exist per the per-module sweep and that the oversized joined 404 must never be cited as missing modules; the invalid probe appears only as an explicitly rejected bad example.
The report affirmatively advises against plugin-side rewrite, retry, or fallback workarounds and against papering over the host chain; no duplicate service insertion is proposed.
